title: Riemannian Geometry of Optimal Rebalancing in Dynamic Weight Automated Market Makers
summary: We show that when a dynamic-weight AMM rebalances by creating arbitrage opportunities, the per-step log loss is the KL divergence between successive weight vectors. The Fisher-Rao metric is therefore the natural Riemannian metric on the weight simplex. The loss-minimising interpolation under the leading-order expansion of this KL cost is SLERP (Spherical Linear Interpolation) in the Hellinger coordinates $η_i = \sqrt{w_i}$: a geodesic on the positive orthant of the unit sphere, traversed at constant speed.
